name: @underlay/cli
description: The Underlay CLI: collections on your machine, scripts that make versions, and push; commands, a terminal UI, and a local server.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.js --external:@aws-sdk/client-s3 --alias:react-devtools-core=./src/tui/no-devtools.ts --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);"
